roles.title: Social Media & Communications Manager
roles.blurb: Shape how Passenger Cinema sounds and looks online: posts, stories, newsletters, and the voice that invites people in.

questions.label: Tell us a bit about yourself
questions.hint: Your background (studies, work, current occupation), and any experience related to cinema, writing, cultural projects, social media or events.

questions.label: Which Instagram account, film platform or cultural project do you think communicates beautifully online? What do they do well?
Do you have experience with social media, design or content creation?
questions.hint: Feel free to share links to work or accounts you have managed. Professional experience is not required.

questions.label: Why would you like to contribute to Passenger Cinema?

roles.title: Film Programmer
roles.blurb: Help decide where we travel next, and what the event around the film should be.

questions.label: Tell us a bit about yourself
questions.hint: Your background (studies, work, current occupation), and any experience related to cinema, writing, cultural projects, social media or events.

questions.label: Propose one film you would screen with Passenger Cinema
questions.hint: Briefly describe the cultural context or the experience you would build around it: discussion, food, music, dance, a guest speaker, anything.

questions.label: Tell us about 3 films that have had an impact on you, and why
Why would you like to contribute to Passenger Cinema?

roles.title: Videographer / Video Storyteller
roles.blurb: Capture what actually happens in the room: the set-up, the strangers talking, the bit after the credits.

questions.label: Tell us a bit about yourself
questions.hint: Your background (studies, work, current occupation), and any experience related to filmmaking, videography, photography, cinema, cultural projects, social media or events.

questions.label: Share 1 to 3 short films, videos, filmmakers or creators whose visual storytelling you really like. What draws you to their work?
Do you have experience filming and/or editing video content?
questions.hint: Links to previous work, a portfolio, social accounts, student projects, anything you have created. Professional experience is not required.

questions.label: Imagine you were making a 1 to 2 minute video about Passenger Cinema. What would you want to capture or explore?
questions.hint: The story behind Passenger Cinema, the process of putting a screening together, the people involved, the atmosphere of an event, or something completely different.
